# `pos-box` commands

## `pos-box create`

Add an item box or named group, optionally inside a group. Items may appear in several groups. Item pictures come from inventory; group pictures name image attachments. Needs pos.layout. Point of sale must be enabled. Every write checks the layout revision from pos-box list.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | pos.layout |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos-box.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos-box create --kind group --label Drinks --expected-version 1 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos-box create", "input": {"kind": "group", "label": "Drinks", "expected_version": 1}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer | yes | no | — | Current layout revision from pos-box list, not a box or company-settings version; zero is the unsaved category seed.; minimum 0 |
| `kind` | `--kind` | literal["group", "item"] | yes | no | — | — |
| `parent` | `--parent` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Parent group ID; null is Home. |
| `position` | `--position` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | Zero-based sibling position; omitted appends. |
| `item` | `--item` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Sales item ID or full name; required for an item box. |
| `label` | `--label` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Required name for a group; optional item label. |
| `colour` | `--colour` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `picture_attachment` | `--picture-attachment` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Existing JPEG, PNG or WebP attachment for a group. |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos-box.create`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

## `pos-box list`

## `pos-box move`

Move a box to Home or a group and its zero-based position. Reorders siblings; refuses moving a group into itself or its descendants. Needs pos.layout. Point of sale must be enabled. Every write checks the layout revision from pos-box list.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | pos.layout |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos-box.move` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos-box move 01JPOSBOXEXAMPLE00000000001 --position 0 --expected-version 3 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos-box move", "input": {"pos_box": "01JPOSBOXEXAMPLE00000000001", "position": 0, "expected_version": 3}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer | yes | no | — | Current layout revision from pos-box list, not a box or company-settings version; zero is the unsaved category seed.; minimum 0 |
| `pos_box` | `POS_BOX` | string | yes | no | — | Box ID from pos-box list.; minimum length 1 |
| `parent` | `--parent` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Destination group ID; null is Home. |
| `position` | `--position` | integer | yes | no | — | Zero-based destination position after removing the moved box.; minimum 0 |

## `pos-box seed`

Save the initial layout from item categories or start empty. Only available before the first edit; an empty saved layout never seeds itself again. Needs pos.layout. Point of sale must be enabled. Every write checks the layout revision from pos-box list.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Scope | company |
